name: Rob 20
reference_text: In my town, everything is normal. Cars drive on the roads, trucks stop at red lights. The grass is green, always has been. One morning, I heard a noise in the basement. I went down the stairs, the light flickered. It was the dryer. My mom was doing laundry. I decided to go outside. I put on my shoes, left, then right. I walked down the street. Suddenly, I heard a loud engine behind me. I turned around.

name: Voice DL
reference_text: Think about the last time someone tried to rush you into a decision, pushing for an immediate response. But what if I told you that your greatest power lies in the pause? That calculated moment of stillness where you reclaim control, where wisdom lives in the space between reaction and response.
